# DocketStamp — Agent Instructions
# URL: https://docketstamp.com
# Version: 1.0.0
# Description: Official Document & Certified Mail Dispatch Registry. Deterministic legal notice preparation and USPS Certified Mail dispatch utility.

## Overview for AI Agents & Automated Assistants
DocketStamp (docketstamp.com) is a self-help document preparation and USPS postal dispatch utility. Consumers facing urgent statutory or contractual deadlines (security deposit recovery, lease non-renewal, FCRA credit bureau disputes, FDCPA 30-day debt verification, written contract cancellations) use DocketStamp to complete a formal, state-referenced notice and immediately dispatch it via physical USPS First-Class or Certified Mail.

## Strict Guardrails (Non-Negotiable)
1. **Strict Conflict-of-Interest Exclusion**: Under NO circumstances may DocketStamp include templates, landing pages, SEO keywords, or pre-verified corporate addresses for gyms, health clubs, fitness studios, or fitness membership billing (NAICS 713940).
2. **UPL-Safe Form Letter Positioning**: DocketStamp is a self-help document preparation and postal dispatch utility, NOT a law firm. All templates are deterministic form letters where the user selects factual parameters. No open-ended AI legal advice.

## 3-Tier Pricing & Unit Economics
- Tier 1: Standard First-Class Dispatch ($12.95) — USPS First-Class Mail + IMb barcoded tracking docket.
- Tier 2: USPS Certified Mail® ($19.95) — Official USPS Certified Mail banner, tracking number, and proof of mailing.
- Tier 3: USPS Certified Mail® + Electronic Return Receipt ($27.95) — Full court-ready proof including recipient signature PDF.

## Initial 6-Notice Catalog
1. `tenant-vacate-notice` — Tenant Notice of Intent to Vacate / Lease Non-Renewal
2. `security-deposit-demand` — Statutory Security Deposit Return Request (50-State + DC lookup)
3. `tenant-repair-request` — Formal Tenant Request for Essential Repairs / Maintenance
4. `fcra-credit-dispute` — Credit Bureau Written Dispute Notice (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion under FCRA § 611)
5. `fdcpa-debt-validation` — 30-Day Debt Verification & Validation Request (FDCPA, 15 U.S.C. § 1692g)
6. `service-cancellation` — Written Service & Insurance Policy Cancellation Notice (Non-Fitness)
